notes: The catalog text contains only the Criminology-Corrections Associate in Science section (Major #M.P888A.AS, Total 30.0 units, two learning outcomes, 'Select 27-30 units' list of 14 CRIM courses plus 'Select 0-3 units' from CRIM 5, 7, 10). No Certificate of Achievement section is printed, so no blocks, totals, outcomes or careers were recorded for the certificate.

The closed list (8 courses, 24 units) differs from the A.S. list (17 courses, 30 units), so the certificate's requirements cannot be assumed to match the A.S.; a reviewer should locate the certificate's own catalog page.

The A.S. section's outcomes ('Recognize the functions of the Criminal Justice System - Corrections.'; 'Be able to work within a Constitutional framework in corrections.') and its description of career areas belong to the A.S. award and were not recorded here.
